水に隣接させ、燃料（石炭・木炭・灯油）を入れると、背後の管へ最高 400 kPa: Place next to water and feed it fuel (coal, charcoal, kerosene) to send steam up to 400 kPa into the pipe behind it.
最高 1000 kPa。量も通常の3倍強。繊細な設備には減圧弁を挟む。水が隣に必: Up to 1000 kPa, with over 3× the volume. Put a pressure-reducing valve before delicate machines. Needs water next to it.
刃を鉱脈に向けて置く。左右向きなら反対側へ、上下向きなら右へ出す。: Point the bit at a vein. Facing sideways it outputs to the opposite side; facing up/down it outputs to the right.
原油だまりに向けて置く。原油の樽をくみ出す。: Point it at an oil pocket. Pumps out barrels of crude oil.
真上に土や岩がない場所で、蒸気の温室が木を育てる。温室は 250 kPa までな: Where there is no dirt or rock directly above, a steam greenhouse grows trees. The greenhouse only takes up to 250 kPa, so a direct boiler feed is overpressure — add a pressure-reducing valve.
鉄鉱石→鉄板、銅鉱石→銅板。: Iron ore → iron plate, copper ore → copper plate.
原油→灯油。灯油は長持ちする燃料で、売り物にもなる。: Crude oil → kerosene. Kerosene is a long-lasting fuel and can also be sold.
指で品目を切替。歯車＋銅板→ぜんまい／ぜんまい2＋鉄板2→自動人形。: Tap to switch product. Gear + copper plate → mainspring / 2 mainsprings + 2 iron plates → automaton.
蒸気を冷やして水に戻す。動いている間は、隣のボイラーが水辺でなくても動く。: Cools steam back into water. While running, boilers next to it work even away from water.
1100〜1400 kPa で鉄板と石炭から特殊合金を作る。1400 kPa を: Makes special alloy from iron plate and coal at 1100–1400 kPa. Above 1400 kPa it explodes, blowing away the surrounding pipes.
空の見える場所で果実を育てる。150〜250 kPa に保つと上等な果実になる。: Grows fruit where the sky is visible. Keep it at 150–250 kPa for fine fruit.
果実と鉄板を缶詰にする。上等な果実なら高級缶詰になる。: Cans fruit with iron plate. Fine fruit makes gourmet cans.
自動人形に特殊合金の骨組みを入れて、精巧な自動人形に仕上げる。: Fits an automaton with a special-alloy frame, finishing it as an exquisite automaton.
置くと新しい依頼人が訪れ、同時に受けられる案件が1件増える（2か所まで）。: Placing one brings new clients and lets you take one more order at a time (up to 2).
鋳造台で回路の部品数と応答時間を測る。回路設計の案件で、基準の部品数以下なら報酬: Measures a circuit's part count and response time at the casting table. For circuit-design orders, at or under the par part count the reward is ×1.5.
入ってきた品物を何でも燃やして消す。動力はいらない。ベルトの終点や、落とした品物: Burns away any item that enters. Needs no power. Good at the end of a belt or under falling items.
【福引き限定】周り6マスに散らばった品物を拾い集めて、隣の貯蔵箱やベルトに入れる: [Lottery only] Gathers items scattered within 6 tiles and puts them into an adjacent chest or belt. Needs no power.
【福引き限定】水も燃料もいらない小さな汽缶。最高 150 kPa で量も少ないが: [Lottery only] A small boiler needing neither water nor fuel. Max 150 kPa and low volume, but perfect for signal lines.
【福引き限定】置いておくと、納期の案件の期限が60秒のび、定時便の間隔の許容が前: [Lottery only] While placed, deadline orders get 60 extra seconds and timed deliveries tolerate 1 s more on each side.
【福引き限定】風で回る羽根が水を沸かす。燃料も水辺もいらないが、真上が空いていな: [Lottery only] Wind-driven blades boil water. No fuel or waterside needed, but it won't turn unless the space above is open. Max 120 kPa.
【福引き限定】普通のベルトの2倍の速さで運ぶ。: [Lottery only] Moves items at twice the speed of a normal belt.
【福引き限定】置いておくと、依頼人の信用が増し、すべての案件の報酬が1割増しにな: [Lottery only] While placed, client trust grows and all order rewards rise by 10% (10% no matter how many).
【福引き限定】工場の前で演奏し、見物客から30秒ごとに ¥20 の投げ銭が入る（: [Lottery only] Plays in front of the factory; onlookers tip ¥20 every 30 seconds (up to 3).
【福引き限定】入ってきた品物を何でも安く買い取る。案件にならない余り物の受け口に: [Lottery only] Buys any incoming item cheaply. A sink for leftovers no order wants.
【福引き限定】通した品物を向きの方へ送り出す。10個に1個、鏡に映った写しがもう: [Lottery only] Sends items through toward its facing. 1 in 10 comes out with an extra mirrored copy.
【福引き限定】底なしの石炭箱。10秒ごとに、隣のボイラーへ石炭を1個くべる。: [Lottery only] An endless coal box. Every 10 seconds it stokes 1 coal into an adjacent boiler.
【福引き限定】周り3マス以内の植物プラントと果樹温室の育ちが1.5倍になる。: [Lottery only] Plant farms and orchard greenhouses within 3 tiles grow 1.5× faster.
【福引き限定】出荷口と同じように納品でき、品物1個ごとに ¥3 のご祝儀が付く。: [Lottery only] Delivers like a shipping dock, plus a ¥3 bonus per item.
何でも50個までためて、矢印へ少しずつ出す。: Holds up to 50 of anything and releases them gradually toward the arrow.
受注中の案件へ納品する。案件に要らない品はくず値（1円）で引き取られる。: Delivers to accepted orders. Items no order needs are taken as scrap (¥1).
同じ番号の気送管へ品物を一瞬で送る。送る側は背後の管から 200 kPa 以上の: Instantly sends items to a pneumatic tube with the same number. The sender uses steam of 200 kPa or more from the pipe behind it.
入った品物を左と右へ交互に出す。片方が詰まればもう片方へ。: Sends incoming items alternately left and right. If one side jams, they go to the other.
入った品物を上と矢印の側へ交互に出す。上は昇降機やベルトがあるときだけ。: Sends incoming items alternately up and toward the arrow. Up only when there is a lift or belt.
入った品物を上と下へ交互に出す。下が空いていれば落とす。: Sends incoming items alternately up and down. Drops them if the space below is empty.
動力なしで、品物を矢印の向きの斜め下へ滑らせる。支えはいらない。: Slides items diagonally down toward the arrow with no power. Needs no support.
入った品物を矢印の向きへ放り投げる。圧が高いほど遠くへ飛ぶ。: Hurls incoming items toward the arrow. Higher pressure throws farther.
品物を5個までためて、真上にある一番近い設備まで一気に吊り上げる（16マスまで）: Holds up to 5 items and hauls them all at once to the nearest machine directly above (up to 16 tiles).
機関車の走る道。横一列につなぐ。両端の間に駅が2つ以上あると機関車が走る。支えは: Track for locomotives. Connect in a horizontal row. A locomotive runs when there are 2+ stations between the ends. Needs no support.
線路の途中に置く。「積む」駅で品物を受け取り、「降ろす」駅で矢印へ出す。機関車は: Place along a rail. “Load” stations take items, “Unload” stations put them out toward the arrow. Locomotives take on water and coal at stations, so it needs 200 kPa+ steam behind it.
左右に運ぶ。端から落ちた品物は重力で下へ落ちる。: Carries left and right. Items falling off the end drop down by gravity.
品物を上へ運ぶ。最上段で矢印の側へ出す。: Carries items upward. Outputs toward the arrow at the top.
背後の管（または重ねた弁の出口）に圧がある間だけ品物を通すベルト。: A belt that only lets items through while the pipe behind it (or a stacked valve's outlet) has pressure.
背後に圧があると床が開き、乗った品物を真下へ落とす。秤弁を同じマスに重ねれば、そ: When there is pressure behind it, the floor opens and drops items straight down. Stack a scale valve on the same tile and it becomes a sorter by itself.
背後に圧があると運ぶ向きが逆になる。上から落ちてくる品物を左右に分けるのに向く。: When there is pressure behind it, its direction reverses. Good for splitting items falling from above to left or right.
空中に床を作る。設備を載せられる。: Makes a floor in mid-air. Machines can sit on it.
蒸気の管。ドラッグで引いた向きにだけつながる。動力も信号も同じ管。: Steam pipe. Connects only in the direction you drag. Power and signals share the same pipe.
管と同じようにつながり、100 kPa 以上（信号の 1）で赤く灯る。: Connects like a pipe and glows red at 100 kPa or more (signal 1).
縦の流れと横の流れを混ぜずに交差させる。: Crosses vertical and horizontal flows without mixing them.
管の途中に付けて、針でその管の圧力を読む。圧力を知る方法はこれだけ。: Attach mid-pipe and read that pipe's pressure from the needle. It's the only way to know the pressure.
矢印側の圧力を設定値まで下げて通す。逆流はしない。タップで設定値を変える。: Lowers pressure on the arrow side to the set value. No backflow. Tap to change the set value.
背中につないだ管の圧が設定値を超えると、余分な蒸気を逃がす。: Vents excess steam when the pipe on its back exceeds the set value.
入口の圧が設定値以上のときだけ開く。圧が足りない間は下流を止めて、大事な設備を優: Opens only when inlet pressure is at or above the set value. While pressure is short it shuts off downstream so key machines get priority.
太い蒸気の管。流れても圧が落ちにくい（普通の管の約5分の1）。幹線に向く。: A thick steam pipe. Pressure drops less as it flows (about 1/5 of a normal pipe). Good for trunk lines.
管と同じようにつながる大きなタンク。圧をためて、需要が跳ねたときに吐き出す。少し: A big tank that connects like a pipe. Stores pressure and releases it when demand spikes. Slowly cools and leaks.
背中の蒸気を余分に食って、矢印側に1.6倍の圧を作る（最大1500 kPa）。燃: Consumes extra steam from its back to make 1.6× pressure on the arrow side (max 1500 kPa). Uses correspondingly more fuel.
背中に圧が来ると鳴る。圧が高いほど高い音。回路の状態を音で知らせる。: Sounds when pressure reaches its back. Higher pressure, higher pitch. Announces a circuit's state by sound.
背中に圧が来た瞬間、決めた音を1つ鳴らす。並べて回路で鳴らせば曲になる。: Plays its chosen note the instant pressure reaches its back. Line them up and drive them with a circuit to make a tune.
背中が給気、左の口が送り。送りに圧が来るたびに次の行へ進み、穴の開いた出口（前・: Back is supply, left port is advance. Each time advance gets pressure it moves to the next row and passes supply to the punched outlets (front/right). 8 rows.
背中が給気、矢印が出口。左の口に圧が来ると開いたまま、右の口に圧が来ると閉じたま: Back is supply, arrow is outlet. Pressure on the left port keeps it open; on the right port keeps it closed. 1 bit of memory.
同じマスのベルトを品物が設定数だけ通るたびに、一瞬だけ開く。: Opens for a moment each time the set number of items passes on the belt on the same tile.
背中が給気、矢印が出口。横の操作口の信号を、設定した時間だけ遅らせて出口に伝える: Back is supply, arrow is outlet. Delays the side control signal by the set time before passing it to the outlet.
矢印の向きにだけ蒸気を通す。合流させるときの逆流止め。: Passes steam only in the arrow direction. Prevents backflow at merges.
背中から入り矢印へ出る。横（操作口）に圧があるときだけ開く。: In from the back, out at the arrow. Opens only while the side (control port) has pressure.
背中から入り矢印へ出る。横（操作口）に圧があると閉じる。: In from the back, out at the arrow. Closes while the side (control port) has pressure.
指でクリックして開け閉めする弁。閉じると出口側を排気する。: A valve you open and close by clicking. When closed it vents the outlet side.
一定周期で開閉する弁。指で周期を変える。: A valve that opens and closes on a fixed period. Tap to change the period.
同じマスのベルトに指定の品が乗っている間だけ開く。同じマスのベルトは、この弁の出: Opens only while the chosen item sits on the belt on the same tile. That belt is driven by this valve's outlet pressure.
鋳造台で作った回路。ポートから蒸気を出し入れする。: A circuit made at the casting table. Steam goes in and out through its ports.
木を育てて木炭にする。燃料の自給。: Grow trees into charcoal. Fuel self-sufficiency.
品物を見分けて仕分ける。秤弁と落とし戸ベルトを重ねるだけで仕分け機になる。: Identify and sort items. Just stack a scale valve on a trapdoor belt to get a sorter.
弁と管を1マスの回路に鋳込む。: Cast valves and pipes into a one-tile circuit.
地下の原油から灯油を作る。: Make kerosene from underground crude oil.
離れた場所へ品物を瞬時に送る。: Instantly sends items to distant places.
圧が落ちにくい太い管。: A thick pipe that holds pressure well.
重力で斜め下へ運ぶ。: Carries items diagonally down by gravity.
圧の山と谷をならす。: Evens out pressure peaks and dips.
水辺から離れてボイラーを置ける。: Lets you place boilers away from water.
手順を穴で書いて動かす。: Program a sequence with holes and run it.
遠くの出張所と本工場を結ぶ。: Links distant outposts with the main factory.
燃料と引き換えに圧を上げる。: Raises pressure in exchange for fuel.
高圧でしか作れない特殊合金。: Special alloy, only made under high pressure.
回路の出来を測る。: Measures how good a circuit is.
鉄鉱石を反射炉で焼いた鉄板を12枚。: 12 iron plates smelted from iron ore in a furnace.
受注から5分以内に歯車8個。間に合わなければ受注前に戻る。: 8 gears within 5 minutes of accepting. If late, it reverts to unaccepted.
銅板10枚。案件に要らない品が1つでも出荷口に届くと、数がゼロに戻る。混合鉱脈か: 10 copper plates. If even one unneeded item reaches the dock, the count resets to zero. Mixed veins also yield iron, so you'll need sorting.
鉄板を4〜6秒おきに1枚ずつ、8回続けて。間隔が外れると数え直し。: One iron plate every 4–6 seconds, 8 times in a row. Off-interval resets the count.
地下の原油を精製した灯油を10缶。: 10 cans of kerosene refined from underground crude oil.
鉄板と銅板を交互に10組（20個）。同じ品が続くと数え直し。: 10 alternating pairs of iron and copper plate (20 items). Repeating an item resets the count.
歯車と銅板から組んだぜんまいを6個。: 6 mainsprings built from gears and copper plate.
自動人形を3体。これを納めれば工廠の名は国中に知れ渡る。: 3 automatons. Deliver these and the works' name will be known across the land.
いつでも石炭を買い取る。何度でも受けられる。: Buys coal any time. Can be taken again and again.
機関車の燃料にまとまった石炭を。: A bulk load of coal for locomotive fuel.
鍛冶組合が鉄板を買い付ける。: The Smiths' Guild buys iron plate.
パン焼き窯用の木炭。植物プラントと炭焼き窯で。: Charcoal for bread ovens. Use plant farms and charcoal kilns.
銅細工の材料。混ぜ物があっても構わない。: Material for copperwork. Mixed-in items are fine.
問屋がいつでも歯車を引き取る。: The wholesaler takes gears any time.
歯車と銅板を交互に8組。望遠鏡の架台に使うらしい。: 8 alternating pairs of gear and copper plate. Apparently for a telescope mount.
銅板を2〜3.5秒おきに10回続けて。短い拍を刻む回路が要る。: Copper plate every 2–3.5 seconds, 10 times in a row. You'll need a circuit that keeps a short beat.
6分以内に鉄板30枚。反射炉を並べて押し切る。: 30 iron plates within 6 minutes. Line up furnaces and push through.
歯車15個。ほかの品が1つでも届けば数え直し。: 15 gears. If even one other item arrives, the count restarts.
鉄板・鉄板・銅板の順を5回（15個）。順番が崩れると数え直し。数を数える回路が要: Iron, iron, copper plate in that order, 5 times (15 items). Breaking the order restarts the count. You'll need a counting circuit.
灯油を6〜9秒おきに1缶ずつ、6回続けて。: One can of kerosene every 6–9 seconds, 6 times in a row.
A と B が両方そろったときだけ止まる信号。下から給気（常に圧あり）が入る。: A signal that stops only when both A and B are present. Supply (always pressurized) enters from below.
2つの1桁を足す。和（XOR）を上へ、桁上げ（AND）を下へ。給気はない。: Add two 1-bit numbers. Sum (XOR) goes up, carry (AND) goes down. No supply.
上の S に圧がなければ A を、あれば B をそのまま下へ通す。: If S on top has no pressure, pass A straight down; if it does, pass B.
A・B・C のうち2つ以上に圧があれば下へ出す。3本の線を交差させる工夫が要る。: Output down if 2 or more of A, B, C have pressure. You'll need a trick to cross three lines.
圧のある入力が奇数本のときだけ下へ出す。チップの中にチップを入れると楽になる。: Output down only when an odd number of inputs have pressure. Putting chips inside chips makes it easier.
果樹温室の果実。上等な果実は別の品なので数に入らない。: Fruit from the orchard greenhouse. Fine fruit is a different item and doesn't count.
営業所を構えた工場にだけ来る依頼。: Only comes to factories with a branch office.
圧力釜でしか作れない合金を6個。爆発に注意。: 6 of the alloy only an autoclave can make. Beware of explosions.
上等な果実だけを詰めた缶詰を8個。温室の圧を 150〜250 kPa に保つこと: 8 cans packed only with fine fruit. Keep the greenhouse at 150–250 kPa.
金賞の続き。特殊合金の骨組みを持つ自動人形を2体。: The gold medal's sequel. 2 automatons with special-alloy frames.
音階管で、前とちがう音を8回続けて鳴らす。演奏の間が3秒以上空くとやり直し。: Play 8 notes in a row on tone pipes, each different from the previous one. A gap of 3+ seconds restarts it.
すでに設備がある（撤去してから）: Something is already here (remove it first)
刃を鉱脈に向ける（R で回転）: Point the bit at a vein (R to rotate)
原油だまりに向ける（R で回転）: Point it at an oil pocket (R to rotate)
最後の出荷口は撤去できない: Can't remove the last shipping dock

設備をタップして状態を調べる。ドラッグで画面を動かす。: Tap a machine to inspect it. Drag to move the view.
土や岩のマスを掘って空間を空ける。鉱脈を掘ると採れることもある。: Dig out dirt and rock tiles to make space. Digging veins can yield ore.
設備や管を撤去する。買った金額の一部が戻る。: Removes machines and pipes. Part of the price is refunded.
管をなぞって色を塗り替える。系統ごとに色を分けると見やすい。: Trace over pipes to repaint them. Coloring each system makes it easier to read.

<p class=\"ds\">鋳造台で組んだ回路。管の途中に置くと、中の弁が入: A circuit built at the casting table. Placed mid-pipe, its inner valves are driven by steam from its input ports.
安全装置がシューシューと蒸気を逃がしている。圧が強すぎるのかもしれない。圧力計で: The safety device is hissing out steam. Maybe the pressure is too high. Check with a pressure gauge.
設備の背後のマスに管を通し、ボイラーまでつなぐ。: Run a pipe through the tile behind the machine and connect it to a boiler.

水のマスに隣接させる。: Place it next to a water tile.
出口（矢印）の先にベルトか設備を置く。: Put a belt or machine past the outlet (arrow).
回転で刃を鉱脈に向ける。: Rotate it so the bit faces a vein.
真上の土や岩を掘って空を見せる。: Dig out the dirt or rock directly above so it can see the sky.
